config.name: Okta sign-ins per minute, by outcome
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       toString(event_outcome) AS outcome,
       count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS "sign-ins/min"
FROM dfe.okta
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND event_action = 'user.session.start'
GROUP BY ts, outcome
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Failed sign-ins in the time range
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT count() AS "failed"
FROM dfe.okta
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND event_action = 'user.session.start' AND event_outcome = 'failure'

config.name: Sign-ins by country, failures first
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT coalesce(client_geo_country_name, 'unknown') AS "Country",
       countIf(event_outcome = 'failure') AS "Failed",
       countIf(event_outcome = 'success') AS "Succeeded",
       round(100 * countIf(event_outcome = 'failure') / count(), 1) AS "Failed %"
FROM dfe.okta
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND event_action = 'user.session.start'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC

config.name: Failed sign-ins by user and address
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT user_name AS "User",
       replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(client_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS "Address",
       client_geo_country_name AS "Country",
       count() AS "Failures"
FROM dfe.okta
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND event_action = 'user.session.start' AND event_outcome = 'failure'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 14
